_comment: Template for the ecosys-pi runtime config file (task 13). Copy it to
config.json (git-ignored) and edit; NEVER commit real credentials.
Precedence, highest first: real PI_ECOSYS_* env vars > .env > config.json >
built-in defaults. A blank value is treated as unset and falls through to
the next layer. Matching is case-insensitive; each key may be spelled with
its short name (ssid) or its canonical env name (PI_ECOSYS_SSID).
Keys under _comment are documentation only and are ignored by the loader.
